# Python packages the browser acceptance check needs (tools/_check_site_browser.py; site.yml
# installs this file): the gate packages of requirements.txt plus Playwright.
#
# Every package is pinned with its hashes and installed with `pip install --require-hashes -r`, so
# a CI run installs exactly these files or fails. The top-level pins live in requirements-browser.in
# (which includes requirements.in); after changing either, regenerate this file from the
# repository root with
#   uv pip compile --generate-hashes --universal --python-version 3.12 --no-header requirements-browser.in -o requirements-browser.txt
# and regenerate requirements.txt as well, so the two locks agree on the shared packages.
